series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 Lesson 2: Noun + から／と／へ／で／まで + の + Noun; に, は, が, を, も cannot take の.
N3 Lesson 4: Noun + に比べ(て); variants に比べたら／に比べれば／に比べると; と比べて largely interchangeable.
N3 Lesson 5: Noun + として 'as (in the role of)'; Noun + としての + Noun.
N3 Lesson 7: Noun + と同じくらい(の + Noun); ぐらい variant; rare kanji 位.
N3 Lesson 7: Noun + と同じで / と違って 'like / unlike'.
N3 Lesson 7 (formal): Noun + と並んで 'in line with, comparable with'; と並ぶほど.
N3 Lesson 7: Noun + に当たる (+ Noun) 'corresponds to, amounts to'; family, translation and proportion examples.
N3 Lesson 10: Noun + に代わって／に代わり 'in place of, on behalf of, to succeed'.

supplementarySources.supports: Row statuses (all eight rows NEW/NEWL) for this set.
Linked from the Bunpro に代わって page as a further reference; not fetched for this set.

dispositions.note: Two items per combined particle; までの (also listed by Bunpro) is mentioned in the article only and no item uses a destination that までの could fill.
Four items against と同じくらい and two against と並んで; と比べて and conditional variants accepted.
Role, status and function senses against に代わって. としての + noun is explained in the article only.
Before an adjective, an adverb and の + noun of measure; one item is the contrast side of に当たる.
Three items per side; と違い accepted as a typed variant.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (Lesson 7; marked formal), page inspected 2026-11-17
dispositions.note: NEWL light entry (2 items) with paired に比べて contexts; と並ぶほど mentioned in the article only.
NEWL light entry (3 items: family relation, translation equivalent, proportion). The contrast with と同じくらい is decided mainly by the slot after the blank.

On-behalf-of (person) and replacement (thing) senses against として. 代わりに (row 215, owned by correction-contrast-connectives) is not an option because the validator would require targeting it; the article explains the difference.

groups.reason: Degree comparison and equivalence extend より／ほう and the existing comparison material.
Similarity and difference frames sit next to the existing comparison groups.
Role and substitution phrases are noun relations next to にとって／に対して.
Particle + の noun modifiers belong with the noun-role and noun-modifier material.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.
